findings.issue: ¿A quién oro? is the 1cs question of orar (I pray). The tokens are a verbless לְמִי זָהָב, to whom + the noun gold; prayer is not licensed and gold is not secured.
el marks fuego as definite. The token is a preposition plus a common singular absolute noun, with no article in the morphology.

notes: Person, number, and stem otherwise match: 1cs dije, 3mp a ellos, hithpael 2mp Arránquense, 3mp dieron, 1cs los arrojé, 3ms salió este becerro.
